instruction: A chunky cartoon leafcutter ant with an oversized head, big glossy eyes and comically large mandibles gripping a single scalloped green leaf held overhead like a parasol. Its three body segments are smooth candy-red with a satin sheen, joined by thin dark waists, and six bent noodle legs end in soft rounded feet. Exaggerated antennae curve upward with tiny ball tips.
